nodes.label: QueryManager
nodes.desc: Coordinator-side registry that accepts submitted queries and drives their lifecycle (createQuery, L316).

nodes.label: SqlQueryExecution
nodes.desc: Per-query orchestrator: start() (L397) plans the query then kicks off distributed scheduling (planDistribution, L523).

nodes.label: LogicalPlanner
nodes.desc: Turns the analyzed statement into a logical Plan (plan, L246) using QueryPlanner and rule-based optimizers.

nodes.label: PlanFragmenter
nodes.desc: Chops the plan into plan fragments that can run in parallel across nodes (createSubPlans, L127).

nodes.label: QueryScheduler
nodes.desc: Coordinator scheduling interface (start, L25) that drives stage execution for one query.

nodes.label: NodeScheduler
nodes.desc: Creates a NodeSelector per session to pick which worker nodes run each split (createNodeSelector, L61).

nodes.label: SourcePartitionedScheduler
nodes.desc: Places the splits of a source stage onto workers one round at a time (schedule, L170).

nodes.label: SqlTask
nodes.desc: Worker-side task endpoint: receives split assignments and output-buffer reads (updateTask, L511).

nodes.label: Driver
nodes.desc: Executes one linear chain of operators, page by page (processInternal, L375).

nodes.label: Operator
nodes.desc: Streaming operator contract: addInput (L47), getOutput (L53), isFinished (L94).

nodes.label: Connector
nodes.desc: Plugin entry point that exposes metadata, split management and page sources (getMetadata, L55).

nodes.label: Page
nodes.desc: Columnar block of rows (L31) - the data unit that flows between operators and connectors.
